No platform writer produces that shape: buildUnknownCallReviewInputV1 already sorts platformTargets (context-assembler.ts:511), platformTargets is derived from undetermined platform items (:1434-1440), and a real crash leaves at most one unresolved non-read-only call because the Kernel serialises any non-read-only batch (vendor/coding-agent/dist/tools/registry/tool-registry.js:133-143; tests/work-graph/K3-06-mixed-kinds-owner.test.ts:6-12). The arm is reached only by a foreign/tampered stored record, which is U, not D2.
